name: Sitar and Tabla
description: North Indian classical instruments: sitar and tanpura, bansuri and harmonium, tabla, with singing bowls and Nepalese bells.
credit: Sounds put together for HO[LO] (CC0): HO[LO] Desk's built-in synths and effects, and the Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (CC0). Each pack keeps its own licence and credit.

source.note: No audio of its own: its sounds play the packs it requires and HO[LO] Desk’s built-in synths.

sounds.name: Sitar
sounds.note: Strings buzzing on the wide bridge (jawari), sympathetic strings ringing along.

sounds.name: Tanpura
sounds.note: Hold Sa: the drone plays Pa, Sa, Sa and the low Sa, round and round.

sounds.name: Bansuri
sounds.note: The side-blown bamboo flute: sweet, with a wide gentle vibrato.

sounds.name: Harmonium
sounds.note: Hand-pumped reeds, breathing with the bellows.

sounds.name: Tabla
sounds.note: The pair of hand drums: the bright dayan and the deep bayan (coming with the Tabla pack).

sounds.name: Singing Bowls
sounds.note: Struck and rubbed bowls, long and beating (coming with the Singing Bowls pack).

sounds.name: Nepalese Bells
sounds.note: Small hand bells (coming to the VCSL pack).
